_PORT_TODO_systemWeb: system.web sections removed: compilation debug, httpRuntime (maxRequestLength=512000KB, executionTimeout=600s), customErrors, pages. Configure Kestrel max request body size and request timeout in Program.cs (e.g. builder.WebHost.ConfigureKestrel(o => o.Limits.MaxRequestBodySize = 524288000)) and set up exception-handling middleware (app.UseExceptionHandler).

Flat keys like 'Bedrock.Region' are now structured sections: use IConfiguration.GetSection("Bedrock")["Region"] or bind to IOptions<BedrockOptions>.
